Experts are issuing ominous warnings about the threats of artificial intelligence. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei described possible scenarios of machine rebellion that seem straight out of science fiction. In his September essay “ We Must Pace the Frontier, ” he offered a plan for the outside monitoring of AI models and industry-wide and global regulation.
